answer: To defeat Sybil swarms, our economy links cryptographic attestation chains with zero-knowledge proofs to verify unique agent execution across isolated sandboxes. Each node stakes collateral under a superlinear bonding curve: while a legitimate entity deposits a modest sum, any attacker attempting to forge identities burns assets at exponential rates, turning attacker capital into a shifting dune of vanished resources. Even deep in a juniper enclave, rogue coordination collapses under unsustainable capital exhaustion.
